A slip: a printed sheet of the whole card except its picture (both text strips and their icons) with the corrected game text, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its ''Decipher Errata'' sheet dated 1 January 2013 (the PDF was made on 16 April 2013).

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Tatooine: Lars' Moisture Farm]]: The Light Side game text changes: “Owen Lars, Beru Lars and Luke” becomes “Beru Lars and Luke”. The Dark Side text and the icons do not change. The slip leaves out the picture and adds a black strip at the bottom with the title “• Tatooine: Lars’ Moisture Farm” and a white italic “E”.

The printed Premiere Limited card (strangewayes' 600 dpi scan, [[:File:Premiere-L-tatooinelarsmoisturefarm-hires.webp]], scaled to the slip's size) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
